[[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Fil/Legends|Fil]] led a '''squad''' of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] on [[Third moon of Vassek/Legends|Vassek's third moon]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It took part in a [[Mission to Grievous's castle/Legends|Mission to Vassek's third moon]] at [[Grievous's castle/Legends|Grievous's castle]] alongside [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] and [[Nahdar Vebb/Legends|Nahdar Vebb]] against [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]].<ref name="Lair">{{TCW|Lair of Grievous}}</ref>

==Description==
The [[Squad/Legends|squad]]<ref name="FF52">{{FactFile2014|52|VAS 1-4|Vassek}}</ref> was composed of five [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] equipped with [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifles]] with [[Ascension cable/Legends|ascension cables]] and were led by [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Fil/Legends|Fil]] and [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Nahdar Vebb/Legends|Nahdar Vebb]]. They utilized a [[Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|''Nu''-class attack shuttle]] for transportation, and sported [[Color/Legends|rusty red]] color markings on their [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]].<ref name="Lair" />

==History==
Before mission to [[Third moon of Vassek/Legends|Vassek 3]], Fil's squad made several missions alongside Nahdar Vebb. They were specialized'' ''in making'' 'entrances' ''by [[Detonator/Legends|detonators]]. During the missions Fil had become a close friend to his Jedi General Nahdar Vebb.

After a [[Rescue on the Tranquility/Legends|skirmish]] on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Tranquility/Legends|''Tranquility'']] with Separatist forces that managed to rescue [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]], Fisto and his former [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], Nahdar Vebb, were dispatched to track down Gunray. Meeting on Vassek 3, Fisto and Vebb, along with Clone Commander Fil and [[Gender/Legends|his]] squad moved into a fortress where they believed a [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacon]] was. [[Niner/Legends|Niner]] and [[Bel/Legends|Bel]] remained by the ''Nu''-class transport and [[Kit Fisto's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Fisto's]] [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor]]. The Jedi and Clone squad found a room where they believed Gunray was being kept, guarded by [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]], but realized it was only a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] of the [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]]. After [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] offered an "alternative prize" to the Jedi, the troopers went deeper into the fortress. There, they discovered that the fortress belonged to [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]].<ref name="Lair" />

Later Grievous went back to his base and discovered Fil's squad inside. He [[Death/Legends|killed]] two of the clone troopers, the Jedi and Fil with only one other trooper. The [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] activated his [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuards]] again to hunt the Jedi. The floor beneath them disappeared and Fisto and Vebb were able to easily jump back onto the floor still remaining, however the clone trooper fell to his death. Commander Fil dispersed his cable, and was pulled back up by the Jedi. Fisto made contact with Niner and Bel in order to bring in reinforcements. While the troopers were trying to make contact with the Republic, the MagnaGuard killed them. Droids were also attempting to destroy Fisto's [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]], but [[R6-H5/Legends|R6-H5]] escaped. A short while after recovering from what had just happened, Grievous deployed his pet [[Roggwart/Legends|roggwart]] [[Gor/Legends|Gor]], in an attempt to finally finish them off. After Fil began firing his blaster at the beast, Gor grabbed him, then repeatedly smacking him against the ground using its tail, ultimately leading to the clone commander's death. Fisto was then able to chop Gor's front limbs off, as Vebb stabbed it in the back. The beast then fell to the ground, as the [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] Jedi stabbed it in the neck, finishing it off. Jedi survivors eventually witnessed Grievous leaving his control room and watched him as he entered a sequence to lock the security door. After Grievous had gone, Fisto went to re-enter the sequence, but as he did, they heard his [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]] alert him that they were trying to enter. The door then opened, and Fisto walked in, but Nahdar did not and protested that they should make an attempt to finish off the cyborg warrior instead. The Padawan destroyed Grievous' bodyguards, but he was killed by General himself. Fisto faced Grievous once again and later escaped from Vassek 3 in his Jedi starfighter.<ref name="Lair" />
